roads.name: County Road 12
words: Properly twisty: 24 curves in 4.0 miles, about 6 a mile.
From 976 to 1,037 ft, with 231 ft of up and down along the way.
July highs average 82°F.
roads.ratingNote: Bars show where it sits among the region's roads; the numbers are each part's share of the rating. At the 55 mph limit its corners still ask for about 0.90 g, so the curves, not the limit, set the pace.

roads.name: Theodore Wirth Parkway
words: Properly twisty: 16 curves in 2.6 miles, about 6 a mile.
The curves flow straight into one another.
From 821 to 903 ft, with 348 ft of up and down along the way.
Wooded nearly the whole way.
12 parks, trailheads and other stops along it, so it's likely busier than most, especially on weekends.
July highs average 83°F.
